idea-plugin.name: Kassi Security Inspections for WordPress
idea-plugin.description:
Static security inspections for WordPress plugin and theme code in PhpStorm: missing capability and nonce checks in admin/AJAX handlers, REST routes without a permission callback, unprepared SQL, unescaped output, unsafe file paths and unsafe redirects.

Deterministic and fully offline: no network calls, no telemetry. Every rule maps to a CWE and is backed by a real, fixed CVE from the WordPress plugin ecosystem.
